shots.scene: 欣欣站在漏斗和抽滤装置前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a glass funnel on a ring stand and a vacuum filtration setup on a bench, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第五课：过滤。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张圆滤纸
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a round piece of filter paper and smiles.
shots.narration: 一张滤纸，学问不少。

shots.scene: 阿杰把没夹的抽滤瓶接上真空，瓶子头重脚轻摇晃
shots.prompt_en: The young male student connects an unclamped filter flask with a heavy funnel on top to a vacuum line, the flask wobbling, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰的抽滤瓶没夹，摇摇晃晃。

shots.scene: 阿杰直接关泵，水倒吸进瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off a water aspirator first, water rushing back into the flask, crossed out.
shots.narration: 滤完直接关泵，水倒吸进了滤液。

shots.scene: 小研摇头，指着缓冲瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and points to an empty trap bottle on the shelf.
shots.narration: 小研：装置和顺序，都有讲究。

shots.scene: 反应后是一瓶混合物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reaction flask containing a mixture of solid particles and liquid, an arrow to a target product icon. No text.
shots.narration: 反应得到的，往往是混合物。

shots.scene: 滤网：水过去，渣留下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a kitchen strainer with liquid passing through and solid bits staying on the mesh. No text.
shots.narration: 过滤像滤网：液体过去，固体留下。

shots.scene: 也能除去溶液里的杂质
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cloudy solution poured through filter paper, a clear solution collected below. No text.
shots.narration: 也能除去溶液里的不溶杂质。

shots.scene: 过滤需要耐心
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a funnel dripping slowly with a patient clock icon and a calm face icon. No text.
shots.narration: 合成离不开过滤，过滤要有耐心。

shots.scene: 常压靠重力，减压靠抽气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a funnel with a gravity arrow on one side, a funnel on a filter flask with a vacuum arrow on the other side. No text.
shots.narration: 常压靠重力，减压靠抽气。

shots.scene: 要滤液，常压过滤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gravity filtration removing drying agent particles, a check mark on the clear liquid collected below. No text.
shots.narration: 滤掉杂质、干燥剂，要滤液用常压。

shots.scene: 量大、赶时间、要固体，用减压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large volume icon, a fast clock icon and a solid product icon pointing to a vacuum filtration setup. No text.
shots.narration: 量大、赶时间、要固体，用减压。

shots.scene: 铁架台、铁圈、漏斗、滤纸、接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ring stand with an iron ring holding a glass funnel with filter paper, a clean receiving flask below. No text.
shots.narration: 铁架台、铁圈、漏斗、滤纸、接收瓶。

shots.scene: 漏斗大小合适
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three funnels of different sizes beside a filter paper, the matching one checked. No text.
shots.narration: 漏斗大小要和滤纸、液量相配。

shots.scene: 【实拍】漏斗颈尖端紧靠接收烧杯内壁
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the long stem tip of a glass funnel resting against the inner wall of a beaker, clear water running down the wall without splashing.
shots.narration: 漏斗颈尖靠紧接收器内壁，不溅。

shots.scene: 滤纸边低于漏斗口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cross section of a funnel with filter paper edge below the funnel rim and the liquid level below the paper edge. No text.
shots.narration: 滤纸边低于漏斗口，液面低于纸边。

shots.scene: 滤纸有细孔，不能留开口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnified filter paper with tiny pores, liquid passing and solid blocked, a gap in a fold crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 细孔拦固体，折时绝不能留开口。

shots.scene: 【实拍】对折再对折，打开一层成圆锥
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands fold a round filter paper in half, then in half again, then open one layer into a cone and set it into a funnel.
shots.narration: 对折再对折，打开一层成圆锥。

shots.scene: 扇形滤纸面积大，流得快
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pleated fan-shaped filter paper in a funnel with many fast flow arrows beside a plain cone with fewer arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 扇形滤纸过滤面积大，流得更快。

shots.scene: 轻折，不压死折痕
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fingertip lightly creasing paper, a hard pressed crease with a small tear crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 轻轻折，别把折痕压死，容易破。

shots.scene: 对折、展开，换方向再对折
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a round paper folded in half, unfolded, then folded in half the other way, two crease lines crossing. No text.
shots.narration: 对折，展开，换个方向再对折。

shots.scene: 【实拍】捏住底部往里推成X，反方向再推
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: fingers pinch the center of the creased filter paper and push the sides inward to form an X shape, then push the other way to make four sections.
shots.narration: 捏住底部往里推成X，分出四区。

shots.scene: 【实拍】每区折两个小三角，一正一反
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: fingers push in a crease in each section to form two small triangles, folds alternating up and down like a fan.
shots.narration: 每区折两个小三角，折痕一正一反。

shots.scene: 初学用四折法也行，多练
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finished fan-folded filter paper with a check mark beside a simple cone paper, a practice repeat icon. No text.
shots.narration: 多练几次就会，初学四折也够用。

shots.scene: 同种溶剂润湿，贴紧无气泡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wash bottle wetting filter paper in a funnel so it sticks evenly to the wall, a trapped bubble crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用同种溶剂润湿，贴紧不留气泡。

shots.scene: 先摇匀，让固体悬浮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask swirled so the settled solid lifts into the liquid. No text.
shots.narration: 先摇匀，让固体悬浮起来。

shots.scene: 【实拍】沿玻璃棒缓缓倒入
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a cloudy sand and water mixture poured from a beaker along a glass rod into filter paper in a funnel.
shots.narration: 沿玻璃棒缓缓倒，分次加。

shots.scene: 液面别漫过滤纸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid overflowing above the filter paper edge and running down between paper and funnel, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 液面降下去再倒，别漫过滤纸。

shots.scene: 滤液浑浊，换瓶重滤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cloudy filtrate in the receiver, an arrow to a clean flask and a new filtration. No text.
shots.narration: 滤液见固体，换干净瓶重滤。

shots.scene: 烧杯壁上还粘着固体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beaker with solid stuck on the wall and bottom after pouring, a magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: 烧杯里还粘着固体，别丢掉。

shots.scene: 【实拍】洗瓶冲洗烧杯，洗液倒进漏斗
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a wash bottle rinses the beaker wall, the rinse poured into the funnel, repeated three times.
shots.narration: 用溶剂冲洗烧杯三次，一起过滤。

shots.scene: 滤纸上的固体也冲洗三次
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wash bottle gently rinsing the solid on the filter paper, a three times icon, drips stopping at the end. No text.
shots.narration: 滤纸上冲洗三次，不再滴就完成。

shots.scene: 少量样品用滴管过滤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny vial of mixture and a glass dropper used as a mini funnel. No text.
shots.narration: 少量样品，用滴管做微量过滤。

shots.scene: 【实拍】搓小棉球，用细丝捅到粗细交界处
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: fingers roll a small piece of cotton into a ball, then a thin wire pushes it down into the narrow part of a glass dropper.
shots.narration: 搓小棉球，捅紧在粗细交界处。

shots.scene: 滴管夹在铁架台上，下接小瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the plugged dropper held by a small clamp on a stand above a small vial. No text.
shots.narration: 过滤滴管夹好，下面放小瓶。

shots.scene: 另一支滴管转入，滤液变清
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a second dropper adds dark mixture into the filter dropper, clear liquid dripping into the vial. No text.
shots.narration: 另一支滴管转入，滤下来变清。

shots.scene: 吸球加压别太猛，挤了不松手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rubber bulb gently pressed on top of the filter dropper, a sudden release with liquid sucked back crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 吸球加压别太猛，挤了别松手。

shots.scene: 棉花上加一层硅藻土
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a layer of fine white diatomaceous earth on top of the cotton plug, very fine particles stopped on it. No text.
shots.narration: 棉花上加层硅藻土，拦住细颗粒。

shots.scene: 硅藻土粉细，防扬尘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spatula adding fine powder gently close to the container, a dust cloud crossed out, a dust mask icon. No text.
shots.narration: 粉末很细，轻取防扬尘。

shots.scene: 抽走空气，大气压把液体压下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: air arrows pulled out of a filter flask through a side arm, big pressure arrows pressing liquid down through the funnel. No text.
shots.narration: 抽走瓶里空气，大气压把液体压下。

shots.scene: 布氏漏斗、带侧管抽滤瓶、厚壁胶管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a white porcelain funnel with a perforated plate on a rubber adapter, a thick-walled flask with a side arm, a thick rubber tube to a vacuum outlet. No text.
shots.narration: 布氏漏斗、抽滤瓶、厚壁胶管。

shots.scene: 量少用赫氏小漏斗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large perforated porcelain funnel and a small narrow one side by side with a small sample icon by the small one. No text.
shots.narration: 量少用赫氏小漏斗，只是大小不同。

shots.scene: 水泵或实验室真空管路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a water aspirator on a faucet and a wall vacuum outlet, both as vacuum sources. No text.
shots.narration: 真空来自水泵、真空泵或真空管路。

shots.scene: 只用厚壁耐压抽滤瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick-walled filter flask with a check mark beside a thin conical flask and a round flat-bottom flask crossed out for vacuum. No text.
shots.narration: 只用厚壁耐压的抽滤瓶。

shots.scene: 用前查裂纹、星裂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier on a flask showing a small star crack, a stop icon. No text.
shots.narration: 用前查裂纹星裂，有伤不能抽。

shots.scene: 有伤的瓶子受压向内爆裂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cracked flask collapsing inward with flying glass fragments, a goggles icon and a shield icon. No text.
shots.narration: 有伤的瓶子会内爆，戴好护目镜。

shots.scene: 【实拍】先把抽滤瓶夹牢在铁架台上
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a clamp tightened around the neck of a filter flask on a ring stand before the funnel is added.
shots.narration: 第一步，先把抽滤瓶夹牢。

shots.scene: 漏斗加橡胶垫圈插紧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rubber adapter or a flat rubber gasket sealing the funnel stem into the flask mouth, an airtight icon. No text.
shots.narration: 漏斗配橡胶塞或垫圈，密合不漏气。

shots.scene: 【实拍】滤纸平铺盖住全部小孔，不上侧壁
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a round filter paper laid flat in a perforated porcelain funnel covering all the holes, its edge not climbing the side wall.
shots.narration: 滤纸盖住全部小孔，不上侧壁。

shots.scene: 滤纸太大剪小；露孔会漏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: scissors trimming an oversized paper, an exposed hole with solid leaking through crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 太大就剪小，露一个孔就会漏。

shots.scene: 抽滤瓶与真空源之间接缓冲瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a filter flask connected by a thick tube to a clamped empty trap bottle, then to a water aspirator. No text.
shots.narration: 抽滤瓶和真空源之间接缓冲瓶。

shots.scene: 水泵停水会倒吸，缓冲瓶拦住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: water flowing back from the aspirator stopped inside the trap bottle, the filtrate kept clean. No text.
shots.narration: 倒吸的水被缓冲瓶拦住，也护泵。

shots.scene: 【实拍】先拔下胶管或开放气阀，再关泵
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand pulls the rubber tube off the side arm of the filter flask, then turns off the water aspirator.
shots.narration: 停时先放气、拔管，再关泵。

shots.scene: 顺序反了：倒吸弄脏滤液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: pump switched off first and water rushing into the filtrate, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 顺序反了，倒吸会弄脏滤液。

shots.scene: 【实拍】开真空，溶剂润湿滤纸吸紧
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a wash bottle wets the filter paper in the porcelain funnel while vacuum is on, the paper pulled flat and tight.
shots.narration: 慢开真空，润湿滤纸，让它吸紧。

shots.scene: 吸不住就是漏气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a filter paper lifting at one edge, a magnifier checking the flask mouth and tube joint for leaks. No text.
shots.narration: 吸不住就漏气，查瓶口和管口。

shots.scene: 倒在滤纸中央，分次加
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mixture poured gently onto the center of the filter paper in a porcelain funnel, small portions. No text.
shots.narration: 倒在滤纸中央，分次加，别溢出。

shots.scene: 真空太大抽破滤纸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a torn filter paper with solid pulled into the flask, a dial turned too high crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 真空太大会抽破滤纸；滤纸别移位。

shots.scene: 滤液别靠近侧管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: filtrate level rising close to the side arm, a warning mark, then vacuum released and the filtrate poured out. No text.
shots.narration: 滤液快到侧管，先放气转出滤液。

shots.scene: 滤完多抽一会，固体更干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: air drawn through a filter cake with a clock icon, the cake turning dry and crumbly. No text.
shots.narration: 滤完多抽一会，固体更干。

shots.scene: 放气后加少量冷溶剂洗涤，再抽干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: vacuum released, a small amount of cold solvent added over the filter cake, then vacuum applied again. No text.
shots.narration: 洗固体：先放气，加少量冷溶剂再抽。

shots.scene: 刮刀取出滤纸，表面皿上晾干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spatula lifting the filter paper with solid onto a watch glass, a blank tag beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 刮刀取出滤纸，放表面皿晾干。

shots.scene: 晾干的样品贴标识，不用手碰
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a watch glass with a blank label showing a name icon and a date icon, a bare hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 样品贴上名称日期，别用手碰。

shots.scene: 有机溶剂抽滤在通风柜里做
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vacuum filtration setup inside a fume hood, solvent vapor arrows drawn away, a flame crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 滤有机溶剂，放到通风柜里做。

shots.scene: 减压使溶剂挥发更快
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: vapor rising faster from a funnel under vacuum, vapor arrows toward the pump, an open flame nearby crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 减压挥发更快，附近不能有明火。

shots.scene: 滤液按成分倒入废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: filtrate poured into a labeled solvent waste container, a sink drain crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不要的滤液按成分收集，不倒水槽。

shots.scene: 沾化学品的滤纸、硅藻土进固废桶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used filter paper and filter aid placed into a labeled solid chemical waste bin, a household trash can crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 沾了化学品的滤纸，进固体废物桶。

shots.scene: 关水泵、关水龙头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand closing a faucet and switching off a vacuum pump, a check list icon. No text.
shots.narration: 用完关泵、关水，收拾台面。

shots.scene: 常压：一贴二低三靠；扇形滤纸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a funnel with paper fitted, levels below the rim and the stem tip against the beaker wall, a fan-folded paper beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 常压：贴紧、两低、管尖靠壁。

shots.scene: 减压：厚壁瓶夹牢，缓冲瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick-walled filter flask clamped on a stand with a trap bottle and a goggles icon. No text.
shots.narration: 减压：厚壁瓶夹牢，接缓冲瓶。

shots.scene: 先放气再关泵
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a two step arrow, a tube pulled off first, then a pump switched off. No text.
shots.narration: 停机先放气，再关泵。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在分液漏斗旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a separatory funnel held in a ring on a stand and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：萃取与反应后处理。
